newsitem.title: USA: Cox sells rights to Alabama radio station.
newsitem.headline: Cox sells rights to Alabama radio station.

text.p: Cox Radio Inc said Wednesday that it has assigned the right to buy its WENN-FM radio in Birmingham, Alabama to privately-held Dick Broadcasting Co Inc for $14.5 million.
The WENN-AM sale should facilitate the U.S. Department of Justice's administrative review relating to Cox's acquisition of three other radio stations in Birmingham, the company said.
Cox previously agreed to buy WENN-FM and WAGG-AM from privately-held Booker T. Washington Broadcast Service Inc for about $15 million.
Pending the close of all announced transactions, Cox said it will own, operate, or provide sales and marketing services to 49 radio stations in 12 markets.
